description: Model Context Protocol server exposing the full Apple Search Ads / Apple Ads Campaign Management API v5 (74 tools, 1:1 endpoint coverage).
author: Yiğithan Yücedağ

tool_signatures.name: adgroup_negative_keywords_create
tool_signatures.description: Bulk-create negative keywords on an ad group.

tool_signatures.name: adgroup_negative_keywords_delete
tool_signatures.description: Bulk-delete ad-group-level negative keywords by ID.

tool_signatures.name: adgroup_negative_keywords_find
tool_signatures.description: Find ad-group-level negative keywords across all ad groups in a campaign with a selector.

tool_signatures.name: adgroup_negative_keywords_get
tool_signatures.description: Fetch a single ad-group-level negative keyword by ID.

tool_signatures.name: adgroup_negative_keywords_list
tool_signatures.description: List ad-group-level negative keywords (paginated).

tool_signatures.name: adgroup_negative_keywords_update
tool_signatures.description: Bulk-update ad-group-level negative keywords. Each entry must include id.

tool_signatures.name: adgroups_create
tool_signatures.description: Create an ad group within a campaign. Bid + targeting live here, not on the campaign.

tool_signatures.name: adgroups_delete
tool_signatures.description: Delete an ad group.

tool_signatures.name: adgroups_find_in_campaign
tool_signatures.description: Find ad groups within a single campaign using a selector.

tool_signatures.name: adgroups_find_org_wide
tool_signatures.description: Find ad groups across the entire org with a selector.

tool_signatures.name: adgroups_get
tool_signatures.description: Fetch a single ad group.

tool_signatures.name: adgroups_list
tool_signatures.description: List all ad groups in a campaign (paginated).

tool_signatures.name: adgroups_update
tool_signatures.description: Update an ad group. Pass only the fields you want to change.

tool_signatures.name: ads_create
tool_signatures.description: Create an ad inside an ad group. Ads bind a Creative (creativeId) to the ad group; the creative itself can wrap a Custom Product Page, Default Product Page, or Creative Set reference.

tool_signatures.name: ads_delete
tool_signatures.description: Delete an ad.

tool_signatures.name: ads_find_in_campaign
tool_signatures.description: Find ads across all ad groups in a campaign with a selector.

tool_signatures.name: ads_find_org_wide
tool_signatures.description: Find ads across the entire org with a selector.

tool_signatures.name: ads_get
tool_signatures.description: Fetch a single ad by ID.

tool_signatures.name: ads_list
tool_signatures.description: List all ads in an ad group.

tool_signatures.name: ads_update
tool_signatures.description: Update an ad — typically status, name, or repointing to a different creativeId.

tool_signatures.name: apple_search_ads_request
tool_signatures.description: Escape hatch: call any Apple Search Ads endpoint by method + path. Authentication and org context are handled for you. Use only if no dedicated tool covers the endpoint you need.

tool_signatures.name: apps_assets_find
tool_signatures.description: Find App Store screenshots / app-preview assets for an app — returns assetGenIds you can use to author creatives or audit rejected assets.

tool_signatures.name: apps_eligibilities_find
tool_signatures.description: Find app-eligibility records by selector (filterable by supplySource, countryOrRegion, deviceClass, state).

tool_signatures.name: apps_get
tool_signatures.description: Fetch App Store metadata for an app: appName, developerName, primaryGenre, secondaryGenre, iconPictureUrl, availableStorefronts, deviceClasses, etc.

tool_signatures.name: apps_locale_details
tool_signatures.description: Get localized default product-page details for an app (subtitle, short description, screenshots, app preview) per locale.

tool_signatures.name: budget_orders_create
tool_signatures.description: Create a budget order (LOC accounts only). Wraps Apple

tool_signatures.name: budget_orders_get
tool_signatures.description: Fetch a single budget order by ID.

tool_signatures.name: budget_orders_list
tool_signatures.description: List all budget orders in the org (paginated).

tool_signatures.name: budget_orders_update
tool_signatures.description: Update a budget order. Most fields are editable post-creation; status is read-only. v5 has no delete endpoint for budget orders.

tool_signatures.name: campaign_negative_keywords_create
tool_signatures.description: Bulk-create campaign-level negative keywords (apply across all ad groups).

tool_signatures.name: campaign_negative_keywords_delete
tool_signatures.description: Bulk-delete campaign-level negative keywords by ID.

tool_signatures.name: campaign_negative_keywords_find
tool_signatures.description: Find campaign-level negative keywords within a single campaign with a selector.

tool_signatures.name: campaign_negative_keywords_get
tool_signatures.description: Fetch a single campaign-level negative keyword by ID.

tool_signatures.name: campaign_negative_keywords_list
tool_signatures.description: List campaign-level negative keywords (paginated).

tool_signatures.name: campaign_negative_keywords_update
tool_signatures.description: Bulk-update campaign-level negative keywords.

tool_signatures.name: campaigns_create
tool_signatures.description: Create a new campaign. The minimum useful body specifies adamId, name, countriesOrRegions, adChannelType, supplySources, billingEvent, and a budget.

tool_signatures.name: campaigns_delete
tool_signatures.description: Permanently delete a campaign. Cannot be undone.

tool_signatures.name: campaigns_find
tool_signatures.description: Search campaigns with a selector — supports conditions (EQUALS/IN/CONTAINS/...), orderBy, and pagination.

tool_signatures.name: campaigns_get
tool_signatures.description: Fetch a single campaign by ID.

tool_signatures.name: campaigns_list
tool_signatures.description: List all campaigns in the org (paginated). For richer filtering use campaigns_find.

tool_signatures.name: campaigns_update
tool_signatures.description: Update a campaign. Pass only the fields you want to change. Use clearGeoTargetingOnCountryOrRegionChange=true if you change countriesOrRegions.

tool_signatures.name: countries_or_regions_list
tool_signatures.description: List supported countries / regions with their default and supported product-page languages.

tool_signatures.name: cpp_get
tool_signatures.description: Fetch a single Custom Product Page by ID.

tool_signatures.name: cpp_list
tool_signatures.description: List Custom Product Pages for an app.

tool_signatures.name: cpp_locale_details
tool_signatures.description: List the locales available for a Custom Product Page (with localized assets per locale).

tool_signatures.name: creative_app_preview_devices
tool_signatures.description: List supported app-preview device-size mappings (e.g. IPHONE_61, IPAD_129). Used when authoring creatives or interpreting screenshot/preview metadata.

tool_signatures.name: creatives_create
tool_signatures.description: Create a creative (a reference to a default product page, custom product page, or creative set). Ads bind to creatives via creativeId.

tool_signatures.name: creatives_find
tool_signatures.description: Find creatives across the org with a selector.

tool_signatures.name: creatives_get
tool_signatures.description: Fetch a single creative by ID.

tool_signatures.name: creatives_list
tool_signatures.description: List all creatives in the org (paginated).

tool_signatures.name: custom_reports_create
tool_signatures.description: Create an Impression Share (Share of Voice) report — async. Returns a reportId you poll with custom_reports_get until state=COMPLETED.

tool_signatures.name: custom_reports_get
tool_signatures.description: Fetch a single Impression Share report — poll until state=COMPLETED to read rows (rank, impressionShare, lowImpressionShare, highImpressionShare, searchPopularity).

tool_signatures.name: custom_reports_list
tool_signatures.description: List all Impression Share reports created in the org.

tool_signatures.name: geo_lookup
tool_signatures.description: Resolve geos by raw IDs. Each request item is { id:

tool_signatures.name: me_user
tool_signatures.description: Return information about the calling API user (userId, parentOrgId).

tool_signatures.name: org_acls
tool_signatures.description: List all org-level ACLs (orgs your API user can access, with orgName / currency / paymentModel / roleNames). Use this to discover the orgId for ASA_ORG_ID. Does not require X-AP-Context.

tool_signatures.name: product_page_reasons_find
tool_signatures.description: Find ad-creative rejection reasons (filterable by adamId, productPageId, assetGenId, countryOrRegion, languageCode, supplySource, reasonLevel). Use this to audit why a creative was rejected by Apple

tool_signatures.name: product_page_reasons_get
tool_signatures.description: Fetch a single rejection reason by ID.

tool_signatures.name: reports_adgroups
tool_signatures.description: Ad-group-level report within a single campaign.

tool_signatures.name: reports_ads_in_campaign
tool_signatures.description: Ad-level performance (per Custom Product Page / creative variation) rolled up across the campaign.

tool_signatures.name: reports_campaigns
tool_signatures.description: Campaign-level performance report. Returns rows with impressions, taps, installs, spend, CPT/CPM/CPI, conversion rate, etc. Pass groupBy to pivot by country, device, age, gender.

tool_signatures.name: reports_keywords_in_adgroup
tool_signatures.description: Keyword report scoped to a single ad group.

tool_signatures.name: reports_keywords_in_campaign
tool_signatures.description: Keyword report rolled up across all ad groups in one campaign.

tool_signatures.name: reports_search_terms_in_adgroup
tool_signatures.description: Search-terms report scoped to a single ad group.

tool_signatures.name: reports_search_terms_in_campaign
tool_signatures.description: Search-terms report rolled up across all ad groups in a campaign. Reveals what users actually typed — harvest new keywords or negatives from here.

tool_signatures.name: search_apps
tool_signatures.description: Search the App Store for apps to target / advertise. Returns adamId, name, developerName, and country availability. You need adamId to create campaigns.

tool_signatures.name: search_geo
tool_signatures.description: Search geo entities by name (Country / AdminArea / Locality). Pass

tool_signatures.name: targeting_keywords_create
tool_signatures.description: Bulk-create targeting (positive) keywords on an ad group. Pass up to 1000 per call.

tool_signatures.name: targeting_keywords_delete
tool_signatures.description: Bulk-delete targeting keywords by ID.

tool_signatures.name: targeting_keywords_delete_single
tool_signatures.description: Delete a single targeting keyword by ID (uses Apple

tool_signatures.name: targeting_keywords_find
tool_signatures.description: Find targeting keywords across all ad groups in a campaign with a selector. Apple does not expose a per-ad-group find — filter by adGroupId in the selector if needed.

tool_signatures.name: targeting_keywords_get
tool_signatures.description: Fetch a single targeting keyword by ID.

tool_signatures.name: targeting_keywords_list
tool_signatures.description: List targeting keywords on an ad group (paginated).

tool_signatures.name: targeting_keywords_update
tool_signatures.description: Bulk-update targeting keywords (status, bid, text, matchType). Each entry must include id.
